messages.author: 598eae3a5857142f
messages.subject: facet_grid and manual breaks
parts:
Hi,

how is it possible to set manual breaks for the y-axis in a facet_grid
with a single column and a few rows?

facet_grid(x ~ ., scale="free")

Each row has different limits but i would like to only show 3 breaks
per row. I can't seem to figure out how though.

Thanks,
Thomas

messages.author: 68b661fcb57b94a9
messages.subject: Re: facet_grid and manual breaks
parts:
I recall this question coming up before in this very group, and IIRC, it cannot be done.

That's assuming that you want different breaks for each facet.

You also can't have different formats (dollar, etc.) for different facets.

But there was some indication from the developer that this capability could be implemented in future releases.

Adam Loveland
